name: Bahamas Choice Real Estate
brand_truth: A small Nassau family brokerage that guides people to and from property on any island, end to end, since 2013.
buyer: Overseas buyers and investors (US, Canada, UK, diaspora) researching for months, and Bahamian families selling family property, often from abroad.

design.signature: Interactive SVG archipelago chart of the 16 island groups they serve; tap an island to see the areas they feature and pre-fill the brief

current_site_findings: About, Meet the Team and Contact pages carry a conflicting noindex tag
Every Featured Areas settlement link points to '#'
Contact page shows no address, phone or map
About page title claims '#1 Real Estate Agents in the Bahamas' without support
Team emails on bahamaschoice.com, site and BREA on bahamaschoicerealestate.com
No guided path for overseas buyers or families selling from abroad
pitch_line: Your own clients say you sold their mother's house from abroad in four months; this site makes that the front door, with your islands on a chart and a brief that lands in your inbox.
assumptions: Buying steps 3-6 wording (negotiate offer, attorney handles legal side) is category-standard paraphrase
Sherry Morris and Erica Pinder job titles not published: shown as 'Bahamas Choice team'
Settlement and development lists taken from their own nav; development locations not mapped
notes: Record said no own site, but bahamaschoicerealestate.com is live (AgentImage WordPress, updated 2026), so pitch as a sharper, faster, lead-focused rebuild, not a rescue. Testimonials quoted verbatim from their own homepage, no stars. Photos hotlinked from their site. Hours unknown (omitted). Island outlines are approximate illustration labelled 'not to scale'.
